statement: server.py changes require restarting BOTH the dashboard (com.github.claude-command-center) AND the worker (com.github.claude-command-center.worker), never just the dashboard
rationale: worker_engines.py does a lazy `import server` (EngineHost._legacy()), so the worker runs its own copy of server.py's module-level state, separate from the dashboard process. Restarting only the dashboard leaves the old code live in the worker, which looks exactly like "the fix didn't work."
